messages:
Maria: heads-up — planning to land engine bundle engine-v3.14.0-quant to staging at 01:00 UTC tonight. This includes the new quant kernels + sigchain for artifacts. Need a pin window and a short release-note blurb.
Charlie: can we keep canary at 5% and a 2-hour pin? rollback criteria? :eyes:
Maria: yes 5% canary. rollback if 10m steady tail latency increases >15% or error-rate >0.5% and if mem pressure climbs >8% over baseline. pin ttl 2h sounds good.
Oliver: deploy-bot command we should run? also who owns the release-note draft?
Maria: i'll own the RN. deploy command below — will run in 01:00 UTC staging slot.
deploy-bot: ``/deploy --env=staging --bundle=engine-v3.14.0-quant --canary=5 --pin-ttl=2h --sig=s3://redwood/artifacts/engine-v3.14.0.sig``
Sabrina: QA: we found one flaky on small-batch inference — quant mismatch warning in logs during sparse matmul. snippet:
```
E 03:14:12 quant-kernel: checksum mismatch 0x7a1f3b4c expected 0x7a1f3b4d
W 03:14:12 fallback: using fp16 kernel
```
Charlie: ok add a preflight checksum verify step. we've had stray artifact copies before. Maria can you pin the sig in the release metadata?
Maria: done — added preflight step to staging job: ``checksigs --artifact s3://redwood/artifacts/engine-v3.14.0.tar.gz --sig s3://redwood/artifacts/engine-v3.14.0.sig`` and a checksum compare with repo hash.
Maria: also adding a short RN blurb: "engine v3.14.0-quant: improved quant kernels with better sparse matmul performance; includes artifact signature verification and fallback telemetry. See CHANGELOG snippet for perf numbers."
Oliver: can we get eng-oncall to watch the canary metric set? especially kv-cache eviction rate and p99 latency.
Maria: @eng-oncall can you be on watch from 01:00–04:00 UTC? we'll escalate on any sustained anomaly. :thumbsup:
eng-oncall: I can watch. will set alert if p99 > baseline*1.15 for 10m or evict-rate rises >2x.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy triggered by Maria at 01:00 UTC — staging canary 5%, pin-ttl 2h. Logs: https://console.internal/redwood/deploys/7102223344
Sabrina: i'll run the small-batch reproducer during canary. if it hits the mismatch i'll attach logs to the deploy ticket.
Charlie: reminder: if we hit checksum mismatch we abort and set pin on the previous good bundle with ``/pin engine-v3.13.9 3h`` until we root-cause. keep everyone pinged.
Maria: agreed. I'll prepare the rollback playbook and small RN edit that notes fallback behavior for fp16.
deploy-bot: stage deploy started — canary slice created (5%).
deploy-bot: stage deploy completed — canary healthy at t+12m. telemetry: p50/p95 stable, p99 +3% (within gate).
Sabrina: no reproducible mismatch in first canary slice. :relieved:
Charlie: nice. after 30m if metrics stay we can widen to 20% and then to 100% with rolling drains.
Maria: widening at t+32m to 20% now.
deploy-bot: widen to 20% — command executed.
eng-oncall: watching — p99 still within 5% and mem stable.
Maria: good — plan to unpin at t+2h unless we see any sag. will post final RN and close the ticket after verification.
Charlie: thanks all. small follow-up: add a config lint to the CI so future sigchain drift is caught earlier.
Maria: filing a quick GH PR for that after this. :sparkles:
